deadline.value: Funded studentships have their own deadlines (see the funding pages); self-funded overseas applicants for September 2027 should apply with a complete application by 30 June 2027.
deadline.quote: Please check our funding webpages for details of funding application deadlines. | Applications from self-funded students are welcomed and have no fixed deadline.

also.quote: if you wish to join in September 2027, please apply with a complete application by 30 June 2027 if you are an overseas student

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: You must name one or two supervisors on the application, and are advised to email them first.
supervisor.quote: It is compulsory to indicate the names of one or two supervisors whose research interests you. We recommend that you contact these supervisors by email in advance of making your application.

funding.value: An offer of admission is separate from any offer of funding; studentships are advertised on the School website.
funding.quote: Offer letters for programmes do not represent any intention to fund. The offer of admission is separate to any offer of funding.

entry_route.value: An upper-second honours degree (or equivalent) in biological sciences or a related discipline.
entry_route.quote: An upper second-class honours degree (or equivalent) in biological sciences or related discipline.

toefl_min.value: English profile E. TOEFL iBT tests from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (older tests: 88 overall).
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level E.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no score below 6.0 (profile E).

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level E.
